n618533c3c0.headline: FG tightens noose on States’ access to loans |
n618533c3c0.summary: The Nigerian Debt Management Office Director General said the federal government is tightening controls on states' borrowing capacity.
n618533c3c0.why: Nigeria's fiscal policy and debt management affect state finances and overall economic stability, influencing credit markets and investment climate.

n2dddacc6c9.summary: Chilean Arauco's attempt to buy Brazilian pulp producer Eldorado Brasil faces three rival offers, according to sources. The report gives no deal terms or closing timeline.
